notes.title: New patch is live!
notes.notes:
Hello, fishermans! Glad to announce new patch with bug fixes and game improvements

[h2]Window screen mode and sound settings[/h2]
Now you can switch the game to window mode in game settings! Be sure to stretch window after switching to state you like

[h2]Fixed chests cooldown[/h2]
Now chests timer should work well and all chest should be delivered in time. Also timer for chest delivering is increased to reduce chance of errors. If you still encounter some problems with chest, let us know

[h2]Localization[/h2]
Added localization for chinese, turkish, italian and ukrainian

[h2]Game UI[/h2]
Added more information for items, stats and ways to obtaining them

[h2]Other bug fixes[/h2]
Achievements now working properly, localization fixes and more
